## Systane Eye Drops

Keep your eyes moist and comfortable with Systane eye drops from CVS Pharmacy. Systane is one of the most popular eye care brands, known for its range of quality products that help alleviate eyestrain, dryness and other everyday conditions.

## Do Systane Eye Drops Have Preservatives?

Eyes are very delicate, so avoiding introducing harmful bacteria that can cause irritation or infections when using eye drops is essential. Systane eye drops generally contain preservatives to help keep the product fresh and give it a longer shelf life after opening. These preservatives also help prevent eye infections, such as pink eye.

Systane products with preservatives generally last up to 8 months after opening. The brand also has preservative-free versions of many of its most popular products, such as [Systane HYDRATION﻿](https://www.cvs.com/shop/systane-hydration-preservative-free-lubricating-eye-drops-vials-30-ct-prodid-391644), offering an alternative option if you experience irritation or allergies from preservatives. These products usually last up to 3 months after opening, making them ideal if you use lubricating eye drops frequently.

To ensure your eye drops remain fresh, always wash your hands before using them, and never touch the tip of the dropper against your eyelids. Store the product in a cool location, out of direct sunlight.

## How Often Can You Use Systane Eye Drops?

Eye dryness has many causes, the most common being eyestrain from spending too much time looking at a TV, phone or computer monitor. It's also common to experience more dryness as you age. Sometimes, dryness results from seasonal allergies, medical conditions or air pollution, so it can be worth getting an [eye exam](https://www.cvs.com/optical/article/eye-exam-101) or consulting your doctor before using eye drops to alleviate the problem.

If you've ruled out treatable causes of dryness, it's typically okay to use Systane lubricant eye drops as often as needed throughout the day. It can also help to follow the 20-20-20 rule by taking a break from reading or looking at screens every 20 minutes and looking at an object 20 feet away for 20 seconds to relax your eyes.

## Which Systane Eye Drops Are Best?

[Systane COMPLETE](https://www.cvs.com/shop/systane-complete-lubricant-eye-drops-10ml-prodid-1990020) is one of the best eye drops for dryness from any source, including aging, eyestrain and reduced tear production. [Systane ULTRA](https://www.cvs.com/shop/systane-ultra-lubricant-eye-drops-prodid-1060136) eye drops are superb for dry eyes caused by spending long hours in front of a screen or irritation from low humidity and dust.

The brand also has options for more severe dry eyes due to medical conditions. [Systane GEL DROPS](https://www.cvs.com/shop/systane-liquid-gel-drops-0-33-oz-prodid-1060129) are a thicker formulation to help relieve extreme dryness overnight, and [Systane BALANCE](https://www.cvs.com/shop/systane-balance-lubricant-eye-drops-prodid-1060149) helps restore your tear film, making it ideal if you have meibomian gland dysfunction.

## Blink Eye Drops

Keep your eyes moist and comfortable with Blink eye drops from the CVS store. Blink products feature potent yet gentle moisturizing ingredients, such as hyaluronic acid, to help provide long-lasting relief from dry eyes caused by eyestrain, allergies and illnesses.

## Can You Use Blink Eye Drops With Contacts?

Contacts can help you see comfortably without the hassle of glasses, but they're also one of the most common sources of dryness. This dryness occurs more readily when you wear your lenses for a long time or use certain types of contacts less permeable to oxygen.

[Blink Contacts eye drops](https://www.cvs.com/shop/blink-contacts-lubricant-eye-drops-prodid-274077) are suitable for most soft and rigid gas-permeable contacts. Other Blink products may also be okay to use with contacts, but it's best to check the product directions, as formulations vary.

## Do Blink Eye Drops Have Preservatives?

Most Blink eye drops contain a preservative called OcuPure, which is only included in minuscule amounts to help prevent bacteria and other microorganisms from growing in the product. While OcuPure helps avert eye irritation by keeping your eyes clean, sensitivity can occur to the ingredient. Luckily, this is rare, so you're unlikely to have a problem using Blink products to keep your eyes comfortable.

If you're sensitive to preservatives or simply want to avoid them, it may be better to choose a preservative-free product, such as [Systane COMPLETE](https://www.cvs.com/shop/systane-complete-multi-dose-preservative-free-eye-drops-prodid-621453) or [Refresh Relieva](https://www.cvs.com/shop/refresh-relieva-preservative-free-lubricant-eye-drops-prodid-2350487). However, these eye drops only last a few months after opening, so they're not as ideal if you use them infrequently.

## How Often Can I Use Blink Eye Drops?

Blink dry eye drops can be used several times throughout the day, and you can even apply them daily for many weeks or months if necessary. Follow all package directions, and check with your optometrist if symptoms persist after 72 hours or if you're experiencing dryness but don't know the cause.


Dryness from relatively harmless triggers, such as staring too long at screens or exposure to airborne allergens, should respond well to eye drops. If it doesn't, or if you find yourself reapplying eye drops frequently, this may signal that you need a more potent product, such as [Blink Triple Care](https://www.cvs.com/shop/blink-triple-care-lubricating-eye-drops-moderate-severe-dry-eye-34-oz-prodid-523032).

Certain conditions, such as morning dryness, may also respond better to a longer-lasting or overnight product, such as [Blink GelTears](https://www.cvs.com/shop/blink-gel-tears-moderate-severe-dry-eye-lubricating-eye-drops-prodid-622742). Because this product hydrates throughout the night, it can help prevent dryness when you wake, reducing your use of eye drops during the day.

The [list](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-warns-consumers-not-purchase-or-use-certain-eye-drops-several-major-brands-due-risk-eye#eyedrops) has been updated to include the sixth product. Additionally, Harvard Drug Group LLC also initiated a voluntary nationwide recall for all lots of two [Rugby Laboratories](https://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/harvard-drug-group-llc-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-certain-rugbyr-laboratories-brand-eye) brand eye drops. The agency has updated the [list](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-warns-consumers-not-purchase-or-use-certain-eye-drops-several-major-brands-due-risk-eye#eyedrops) of products to include the national drug codes (NDCs) that have been confirmed. FDA will provide additional information as it becomes available. **\[10/30/2023\]** FDA is updating the [list](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-warns-consumers-not-purchase-or-use-certain-eye-drops-several-major-brands-due-risk-eye#eyedrops) of over-the-counter eye drop products consumers should not purchase or use to include Equate Hydration PF Lubricant Eye Drop 10 mL sold by Walmart in stores and online. Walmart is removing the product from their store shelves and website. **\[10/27/2023\]** FDA is warning consumers not to purchase and to immediately stop using [26 over-the-counter eye drop products](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-warns-consumers-not-purchase-or-use-certain-eye-drops-several-major-brands-due-risk-eye#eyedrops) due to the potential risk of eye infections that could result in partial vision loss or blindness. FDA recommended the manufacturer of these products recall all lots on October 25, 2023, after agency investigators found insanitary conditions in the manufacturing facility and positive bacterial test results from environmental sampling of critical drug production areas in the facility.
